option_relations.rationale: NK/T-Cell Lymphoma, Nasal Type is a specific subtype of extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, which is distinct from the broader category of Peripheral T-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified (PTCL-NOS).
Peripheral T-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma is a broader category that includes Peripheral T-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified (PTCL-NOS) as a subtype.
Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma is a distinct entity from Peripheral T-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified (PTCL-NOS), although both are types of non-Hodgkin lymphoma.
ALK-negative anaplastic large cell lymphoma is a specific subtype of T-cell lymphoma, but it is distinct from Peripheral T-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified (PTCL-NOS).
